title: Probiotics in Elderly Patients With Medical Conditions
brief_summary: Study of efficacy of probiotic in older patients with multiple co-morbidites and constipation
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-clinical diagnosis of constipation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Parkinson's disease,
* spinal cord lesions
* post radiation strictures
* on calcium supplements of greater than 1,500 mg per day
* immune-deficiency
* critical illness
